title: JoJo | KEY.co
description_expanded: Overlooking charming Ruskin Park in the heart of Seaside, this exquisitely renovated townhome blends artistic design with coastal comfort in one of 30A’s most coveted locations. Just a four-minute stroll to the beach and mere steps from Central Square, this two-bedroom, three-bath retreat offers over 2,700 square feet of thoughtfully curated living space. Owned by an interior decorator, every corner of the home reflects a designer’s touch—from vaulted ceilings and layered textures to luxury furnishings and statement lighting. Multiple outdoor spaces, including a spacious rear deck and two private balconies, provide inviting spots to enjoy the park views or sip your morning coffee beneath the trees of Fairy Forest.
